description: Game-world <-> minimap coordinate transform for Ascent. Values taken directly from valorant-api.com/v1/maps (read 2026-11-18, HTTP 200). The transform maps Unreal game-world (x,y) into normalized minimap space in the range [0,1] with an axis swap. Verified: all 22 Ascent callout locations map into [0,1] under this orientation (see tools/map-processor/verify-transform.mjs).

units.note: unitsPerMeter=100 (1 uu = 1 cm) is the standard Unreal/VALORANT convention. Treat distances derived from this as manual-approx until confirmed against an in-game measurement.

notes: The axis-swapped orientation (minimapX uses gameY) was determined empirically by checking that all callouts land in [0,1]; it matches the widely used valorant-api minimap convention.
patchVersion unknown: valorant-api does not stamp the map geometry with a game patch.
